summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its purchase of Evofem Biosciences' senior subordinated convertible notes and purchase rights from multiple sellers. Hub issued 31,623,000 of its ordinary shares (valued at $1.560/share, based on June 24, 2026 closing price) as consideration, totaling ~$49.3 million. No board recommendation or advisors named. The acquired notes and rights are convertible/exercisable at $0.0154/share into ~1 billion Evofem shares, giving Hub ~88% ownership on a basic basis but only 14% fully diluted due to other instruments. The deal closed on June 26, 2026. The non-US filing is treated as a current report. Watch for regulatory review of ownership limits and potential subsequent steps by Hub to consolidate Evofem.
